therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation suppression and autoimmune inflammation reduction
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with active lupus nephritis (glomerulonephritis) on background mycophenolate mofetil and prednisone
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants achieving complete renal response (CR) at Day 365

results.target_engagement_evidence: Trough serum concentrations (Cmin) maintained throughout dosing period (geometric mean 13.62–90.46 µg/mL across timepoints); Cmax Day 1: 527.43 µg/mL
biomarker_changes: Adjusted mean change in UPCR at Day 365 (overall): abatacept -2.99 vs placebo -2.90 mg/mg
Adjusted mean change in UPCR at Day 365 (nephrotic): abatacept -5.01 vs placebo -4.84 mg/mg
Adjusted mean change in eGFR at Day 365: abatacept +6.85 vs placebo +5.85 mL/min/1.73m²
Adjusted mean change in BILAG 2004 score Year 1: abatacept -8.22 vs placebo -7.60
Median percent change in UPCR at Day 365: abatacept -83.77% vs placebo -84.12%
Albumin change at Day 729: abatacept +9.2 g/L vs placebo +8.1 g/L
Lymphocyte count change at Day 729: abatacept +0.141 vs placebo -0.149 x10^9 cells/L
subgroup_findings: CR at Day 729 (overall population): abatacept 61.9% vs placebo 52.7%
CR at Day 729 (nephrotic): abatacept 50.0% vs placebo 49.0%
Median time to CR (all participants, Day 729 analysis): abatacept 170 days vs placebo 282 days
Lupus treatment failure at Day 365: abatacept 3.5% vs placebo 4.4%
Overall treatment failure at Day 729: abatacept 5.2% vs placebo 8.4%
safety_signals: Serious AEs Year 1: abatacept 49/202 vs placebo 39/203
Infection AEs Year 1: abatacept 150/202 vs placebo 147/203
Autoimmune events Year 1: abatacept 10 vs placebo 9
Acute infusional AEs: abatacept 2 vs placebo 4
Marked ALT elevations (Year 1): abatacept 8 vs placebo 2
Marked AST elevations (Year 1): abatacept 5 vs placebo 0
Marked GGT elevations (Year 1): abatacept 17 vs placebo 15
Marked BUN elevations (Year 1): abatacept 20 vs placebo 12
Marked creatinine elevations (Year 1): abatacept 24 vs placebo 20
Marked lymphocyte low (Year 1): abatacept 81 vs placebo 104

context.duration: Up to 729 days (approximately 2 years) double-blind period
context.investigator_commentary: Trial terminated due to inability to meet protocol objectives. The primary endpoint (complete renal response at Day 365) was not met (OR 1.08, p=0.7264). The trial was stopped early; double-blind therapy ended July 1, 2017.

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Abatacept costimulation blockade was hypothesized to amplify the immunosuppressive effect of mycophenolate mofetil by additionally suppressing T-cell driven autoimmune nephritis, but the combination showed no benefit over mycophenolate mofetil plus placebo
modulation_entries.citation: Adjusted odds ratio is estimated from logistic regression model... OR = 1.08 (95% CI: 0.7077–1.6421), p = 0.7264

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Prednisone provides background broad immunosuppression that may amplify mycophenolate mofetil's lymphocyte-targeted suppression in lupus nephritis; both arms received prednisone so differential effect cannot be assessed
modulation_entries.citation: BMS-188667 + Mycophenolate mofetil + Prednisone... Placebo + Mycophenolate mofetil + Prednisone
